verdict.rationale: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant, so asking whether a user can opt out of AI-model training is a fair privacy question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions training opt-outs, data-use policies or model-training controls; the citations cover only APIs, webhooks, SDKs, MCP and pricing features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
